# rustinion_group_portable_policy (Resource)

Manages a group's portable-device policy. Portable devices (laptops, travel machines) that stop checking in show as Away instead of raising stale/offline alerts, incidents or emails, their compliance clocks pause and no restarts are scheduled for them; after the grace period they raise one low-severity notice. A device's own Portable setting (device page, or PUT /api/v1/customer/devices/{id}/portable) overrides the group's. The asleep grace applies to every device in the group whose agent announced sleep or shutdown. Destroying this resource puts the defaults back (not portable, 14 days, 48 hours).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `asleep_grace_hours` (Number) Hours a device that announced sleep or shutdown shows as Asleep without stale alerts, 1-336. Default 48.
- `auto_mark_portable` (String) What to do with devices that look portable (laptop chassis or battery, GL.iNet travel routers, Wi-Fi-client / tethered / cellular uplinks, frequently changing networks): `suggest` (default: a one-click suggestion on the device page, device list and compliance report; nothing changes), `auto` (mark them Portable automatically, audit-logged, never over a device explicitly set to Off) or `off` (no suggestions).
- `portable_devices` (Boolean) Devices in this group are portable by default.
- `portable_grace_days` (Number) Days a portable device may be away before its one notice, 1-365. Default 14.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
